headline: Sources: Colts' Keenan Allen faces minimum 3-game suspension
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen, who was formally charged last week with two misdemeanor offenses stemming from his drunken driving arrest in downtown Indianapolis last month, is facing a minimum three-game suspension, sources told ESPN.

headline: Browns will make "evaluation" of quarterback position after Week 2
summary: When the Browns decided, two days after an all-time press-conference meltdown from Deshaun Watson, to make him the Week 1 starting quarterback, it immediately seemed to be a product of the fact that Cleveland starts the season with two games, you know, not in Cleveland.

headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold Could Be Out Until October
summary: The Seahawks have been hesitant to provide a clear timeline for the return of quarterback Sam Darnold from the injury he suffered in Week 1. Initial concerns about Darnold’s hip were allayed by testing that indicated his glute was impacted instead. headline: Sam Darnold is "recovering faster than anyone had anticipated"
summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold left the Week 1 game against the Patriots after five snaps, with a hip injury becoming a glute tendon injury for which the team reportedly sought multiple second opinions.

headline: Ravens' Zay Flowers downgraded to out because of hamstring injury
summary: The Baltimore Ravens downgraded Pro Bowl wide receiver Zay Flowers to out for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
